notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.content:
[b][h2]Bug fixes:[/h2][/b]


[list]
[*] Permanent upgrades are now safely saved—no more disappearing upgrades!
[*] Fixed an issue with the save system that reset the day counter to 1 when reloading. Time marches on properly now!
[*] We double-checked and made sure the tower upgrade bug is truly gone.
[*] Addressed a few sneaky bugs in the assault team’s behavior. They should be fighting fit now!
[/list]


[i]Thanks for sticking with us, and stay tuned for more improvements![/i]

notes.title: The Monarch 1.0.0 is Here!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings [b]Builders[/b]![/h2]

We are thrilled to announce that after more than two years of hard work, The Monarch 1.0.0 is officially here! This release is packed with epic content, including 3 legendary units that will change the way you strategize and conquer your foes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281974/e9bf390dbe891b32d403dcbdde6dbf36ce04aaff.png[/img]

[b]Berserk[/b]: A fearsome warrior with unparalleled strength and rage.

 [b]Shadow Priest[/b]: Master of dark magic, bringing unique support and control abilities to the battlefield.

[b]Bullseye[/b]: The ultimate marksman, skilled in delivering deadly precision strikes.


But that's not all! We’ve added tons of new skills for you to explore, allowing for even more diverse and powerful playstyles. Plus, permanent upgrade features have been introduced to enhance your units and make your journey through the game even more exciting.

Additionally, we have worked tirelessly to squash tons of bugs and implement various quality-of-life improvements, ensuring a smoother, more enjoyable gaming experience.

[h3]We're Still Building![/h3]


Even though this is our 1.0.0 release, it’s just the beginning! We’re still hard at work adding new features, content, and improvements to make The Monarch even better. If you run into any bugs, have suggestions, or just want to chat, come say hi on our [b]Discord page[/b]. We’d love to hear what you think and use your feedback to shape the future of the game!


[i]Thank you for being part of our journey. We can’t wait to see how you will utilize these new features to become the ultimate Monarch![/i]

notes.title: Update Notes for Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
What's up, Kings👑? 

Thank you for playing The Monarch: First Light Prologue
The prologue has been updated recently!

In version 1.0.3:

Some bugs have been fixed.
Performance optimizations have been made.

If you encounter any visual/functional bugs or would like to provide feedback, please join our Discord server and share them with us on the "feedback-bugs" channel to help us for improving the game.

notes.title: Update notes for Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

👑 Thank you for playing The Monarch - First Light! 👑

Here's the patch notes for v1.0.2:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where military units could sometimes go beyond the wall.
[*] Fixed a bug where enemy units could sometimes hit outside of their attack radius.
[*] Enemy units were sometimes getting stuck in combat. This is fixed.
[*] Some localization bugs fixed.
[*] Fixed a bug where your experience gems could go outside the collision zones.
[*] Fixed a crash issue that occurred when attempting to gain a skill.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused peasant units to get stuck during the town center upgrade.
[*] Addressed some save-related bugs.
[*] Corrected a bug where the Wild Boar would get stuck in the running animation and become invulnerable.
[*] Resolved an issue where the Main Menu appeared in a different language than selected.
[*] Fixed a bug where archers could sometimes stall while enemies were attacking the wall.
[*] Fixed a bug where archers could run past walls.
[*] Minor nerfs to 2nd and 3rd enemy waves.
[/list]

Please let us know when you encounter any issue on our Discord or Steam community so that we can fix it asap.

Thank you and have fun!🏹
